description_en: Sends a user message to a specified session or cancels a session
description_zh: 向指定会话发送用户消息或取消会话
name: SendChatMessage

parameters.help_en: The Data Management unit you are currently in. If you select an analytics database, this information is used to correctly connect to your Data Management instance. You can go to the DAS console to view your current Data Management unit. If you are a user on the Alibaba Cloud China Website (www.aliyun.com), you can directly enter cn-hangzhou
parameters.help_zh: 您当前所在的DMS单元。若您选择分析数据库，该信息将用于后续通过DMS正确连接到您的DMS实例。您可前往DMS控制台查看您当前所在的DMS单元，若您是阿里云中国站用户，可以直接填入cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: dms_unit

parameters.help_en: The session ID. This is a required field. You can obtain the SessionId by calling CreateAgentSession
parameters.help_zh: 会话 ID，必须字段。您可以通过CreateAgentSession获取SessionId
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The agent ID. This is a required field. You can obtain the current AgentId from the response of the CreateAgentSession operation. Agent resources have a lifecycle, so the AgentId you need to specify may change with each request
parameters.help_zh: AgentId，必填。您可通过CreateAgentSession接口的返回值获取当前的AgentID。Agent资源存在生命周期，因此您每次请求需要填入的AgentID可能变化
parameters.name: agent_id

parameters.help_en: The message content to send to the agent
parameters.help_zh: 本次向Agent发送的消息内容
parameters.name: message

parameters.help_en:
The message type. Default value: `[primary]`.

Under normal circumstances, when interacting with the Agent, the message type is `[primary]`.

When the message is a response to the Agent's Human-in-Loop question, the type should be `[additional]`.

When the message is intended to trigger a report generation, the type should be `[report]`.

When the message is intended to cancel the current session, the type should be `[cancel]`
parameters.help_zh:
消息类型，默认为 `[primary]`。  

常规情况下，和Agent交互，消息类型为 `[primary]`

当该消息为响应Agent的Human-in-Loop问题时，类型应当是`[additional]`

当该消息是要触发一次报告绘制时，类型应当是 `[report]`

当该消息是要取消当前会话时，类型应当是`[cancel]`
parameters.name: message_type

parameters.help_en:
Important

When this message is a reply to an Agent message (for example, the Agent asks a clarifying question through ASK_HUMAN), set reply_to to the exact Checkpoint number carried in that Agent message. If this message is not a targeted reply, such as requesting the Agent to perform further in-depth analysis after the analysis is complete, leave reply_to empty or set it to "0".

This field affects how the Agent decides to process the message. Passing an incorrect value may cause the analysis results to fall short of expectations
parameters.help_zh:
重要

当本消息是回复Agent消息（如：Agent通过 ASK_HUMAN进行问题澄清），则reply_to应当精确传入这条Agent消息携带的 Checkpoint 序号。若本消息无针对性的回复，如分析完成后要求Agent进一步深度分析，则 reply_to 可不填入或者填入"0"。  

该字段会影响Agent决策如何处理该消息，若传递错误可能导致分析效果不及预期
parameters.name: reply_to

parameters.help_en: The quoted content. This is typically used when interacting with the agent
parameters.help_zh: 传入当前引用内容，通常在与Agent交互时使用
parameters.name: quoted_message

parameters.help_en: This is a required field when the message type is `additional`. Specify the specific question that the agent asks the user through Human-in-Loop
parameters.help_zh: 当消息类型为`additional`时为必须字段，传入Agent通过Human-in-Loop向用户提问的具体问题
parameters.name: question

fields.help_en: The list of columns that are allowed to be queried in the current table. If this parameter is not specified, all columns can be queried. If specified, SQL statements that exceed the allowed scope are blocked. For example, syntax such as SELECT * is blocked. To ensure DataAgent analysis effectiveness, avoid specifying columns beyond the allowed scope in the DataAgent prompts, knowledge, or instructions modules. Otherwise, SQL statements without proper permissions are generated and blocked, which reduces DataAgent analysis speed and effectiveness
fields.help_zh: 当前表允许查询的字段列表。若不填表示都可以查询。若填写，超过允许范围的SQL将会被禁止执行，如类似SELECT * 的语法将会被禁止。为了保证DataAgent分析效果，请注意DataAgent的提示词、知识、指示等模块尽量不要给出超过范围的字段，以免生成无权限SQL被禁止执行，导致降低DataAgent分析速度以及分析效果
fields.name: allowed_columns

fields.help_en: The required row filter condition for the current table. If this parameter is not specified, it is ignored. If specified, all SQL statements involving this table are validated to check whether they include the filter field and whether the WHERE condition meets the constraint. SQL statements that do not meet the constraint are rejected. Ensure the validation condition format is correct
fields.help_zh: 当前表必须携带的行过滤条件。若不填写则忽略；若填写，会在所有涉及这个表的SQL语句里校验是否携带了该过滤字段以及where条件是否满足约束，不满足的SQL会被拒绝执行。请注意校验条件格式
